# Parenting Quotient

> Expert Parenting Tips and Advice

## About

Parenting Quotient (parentingquo.com) gives practical advice on pregnancy, breastfeeding, and child development. We don't do guilt — just evidence-backed strategies that work in the real world. Topics include postpartum recovery, breastfeeding help, baby milestones, and everyday parenting strategies.

## Content areas

### Parenting (/posts/parenting)
Articles on parenting strategies and tips.

### Pregnancy (/posts/pregnancy)
Articles on pregnancy stages, nutrition, prenatal care, and related topics.

### Nutrition (/posts/nutrition)
Articles on child nutrition and healthy eating.

### Breastfeeding (/posts/breastfeeding)
Articles on breastfeeding strategies, guidance, and support.

### Blog posts (/posts/)
Articles on early childhood development, pregnancy, breastfeeding, nutrition, STEM activities, sleep training, milestones, parenting strategies, adoption, and special topics.

### Glossary (/glossary/)
Parenting and child development terminology reference.

### About (/about/)
Information about Parenting Quotient and the team.

## Site structure

- Homepage: featured content, trending posts, latest articles
- Blog: categorized articles with tags
- Social media: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads
- Navigation: works on mobile and desktop

## Target audience

- Expecting parents and parents-to-be
- New parents and caregivers
- Parents of infants, toddlers, and young children (ages 0-6)
- Anyone looking for evidence-based parenting advice

## Key topics

Pregnancy, Breastfeeding, Child Development, Child Nutrition, Parenting Strategies, Early Childhood, Baby Care

## Content philosophy

Our content is:
- Evidence-based and reviewed by experts
- Practical and actionable
- Focused on processes, not rules
- Supportive and non-judgmental
- Accessible to all parents

## Featured articles

### Pregnancy and postpartum recovery
- [Postpartum recovery guide](https://parentingquo.com/posts/pregnancy/postpartum-recovery-comprehensive-guide/): Pelvic floor healing, diastasis recti, safe exercise, and emotional well-being.
- [Thriving through postpartum identity shifts](https://parentingquo.com/posts/pregnancy/thriving-postpartum-identity-shifts/): Dealing with identity changes after having a baby.
- [Safety during pregnancy](https://parentingquo.com/posts/pregnancy/safety-during-pregnancy/): What to avoid — foods, habits, and environmental risks.
- [Healthy weight gain during pregnancy](https://parentingquo.com/posts/pregnancy/healthy-weight-gain/): Trimester-by-trimester goals and nutrition strategies.

### Breastfeeding and lactation
- [Common breastfeeding mistakes](https://parentingquo.com/posts/breastfeeding/common-breastfeeding-mistakes/): Fixing latching issues and positioning for better comfort and milk supply.
- [Breastfeeding while sick](https://parentingquo.com/posts/breastfeeding/safe-breastfeeding-while-sick/): What medications are safe, what to avoid, and how to protect your supply.

### Child cognitive and physical development
- [Child brain development](https://parentingquo.com/posts/parenting/child-brain-development/): How brains grow — sensory processing, language leaps, and abstract thinking.
- [Deworming in children](https://parentingquo.com/posts/parenting/deworming-in-children/): Symptoms, WHO recommendations, treatment schedules, and hygiene.
- [Music and infant brain development](https://parentingquo.com/posts/parenting/music-infant-brain-development/): How music strengthens brain connections and helps language and spatial skills.

### Family wellness and behavioral strategies
- [Digital detox family challenge](https://parentingquo.com/posts/parenting/digital-detox-family-challenge/): Cutting screen time and rebuilding real connections.
- Mindful parenting: staying calm during tantrums, helping kids name their emotions.
- Handling routine changes, travel stress, co-parenting, and parental well-being.
